ScenarioDef.label: Young tribe
ScenarioDef.description:
A group of aborigines are expelled from the tribe by decision of the council of elders, starting their new life.

You are aware of the nearby faction settlements.
You have access to the basic technologies of the tribe.
We recommend this scenario when learning about project.

scenario.summary: A group of aborigines people is expelled by the decision of the council of elders. Surpass council and prove them wrong!

ScenarioDef.label: Lost paragon
ScenarioDef.description: You and a group of like-minded tribesmen decide to take a bold step. You are about to find the lost paragon, artifact and pride of your tribe. None of the living tribesmen have the slightest idea what it is or what it looks like, but you are determined.\n\nThis is a classic Project Paragon scenario. It is quite difficult, so we recommend it to experienced players. You will go from the bottom to the top of civilization.

scenario.summary: Three members of the tribe are trying to establish an independent life and find the lost paragon.

ScenarioDef.label: Lost sheks
ScenarioDef.description: Your group got lost during a long trip to the sea. You tried to catch up with your comrades, but it was all in vain. Few survived, but you are determined to survive.\n\nThis scenario is complicated by your colonists' need for salt.

scenario.summary: Leaving the past, three hungry shek decide to found their own tribe.

ScenarioDef.label: Defender of nature
ScenarioDef.description: You are one of the many treants who have been assigned to spread throughout the area to keep the forests healthy. Are you up to the task?

scenario.summary: An old experienced treant begins an ascetic life in isolation to maintain nature.

ScenarioDef.label: Kairos rebels
ScenarioDef.description: Your small group of supporters staged an uprising in the kingdom, which resulted in a smoldering civil war. In the end, you were defeated and forced into eternal exile.

scenario.summary: A group of rebellious kairos flee the kingdom to create a new future.

li.text: Your small group of supporters staged an uprising in the kingdom, which resulted in a smoldering civil war. In the end, you were defeated and forced into eternal exile.

ScenarioDef.label: Hive traitors
ScenarioDef.description: You and a few members of the hive have exhibited an unorthodox intellectual capacity that has allowed you to become truly conscious. You escape the hive and begin a long journey of exile.\n\nYou are aware of the location of nearby arachnid hives.

scenario.summary: Several arachnids have broken away from the hive and are starting their fight for survival.

ScenarioDef.label: Lost arachnid worker
ScenarioDef.description: You and several members of your hive made a long journey to establish a new nest. Death and hunger have destroyed everyone except you. Can you restore the hive?

scenario.summary: The last surviving arachnid worker tries to restore the hive.

li.text: You and several members of your hive made a long journey to establish a new nest. Death and hunger have destroyed everyone except you. Can you restore the hive?

ScenarioDef.label: Aeron refugees
ScenarioDef.description: You and several other subjects of the kingdom are unhappy with high taxes and poverty. In the end, you decide to leave your homeland and start a new life.\n\nYou are aware of the location of the nearby aeron settlements.

scenario.summary: A small group of aerons flee the oppression of their kingdom with the hope of a new future.

li.text: You and several other subjects of the kingdom are unhappy with high taxes and poverty. In the end, you decide to leave your homeland and start a new life.\n\nYou are aware of the location of the nearby aeron settlements.

ScenarioDef.label: Shard of the Horde
ScenarioDef.description: A small group of tauruses challenge their Khan, which leads to a bloody civil strife. In the end, the rebellion was crushed, many of the organizers were executed, but the horde received significant damage. Can you take revenge?

scenario.summary: A group of surviving rebels are preparing revenge and eager to take over the world.

ScenarioDef.label: Bloody sect
ScenarioDef.description: You and a few rank-and-file zorgs are unhappy with the policy of your leader, who carries out too few executions and does not wage wars of conquest. Once organized, you leave the tribe.

scenario.summary: A few zorgs form a bloody host.

li.text: You and a few rank-and-file zorgs are unhappy with the policy of your leader, who carries out too few executions and does not wage wars of conquest. Once organized, you leave the tribe.

ScenarioDef.label: Automaton colonization
ScenarioDef.description: A group of machines left at the old factory is activated. It is unknown who built the factory and why it was abandoned. The machines have to survive and rebuild a new factory.

scenario.summary: A group of machines left at the old factory is activated.

ScenarioDef.label: Battlefield
ScenarioDef.description: The assault on the ruined fortress breaks down after a treacherous betrayal by a group of heretics. Can you lead them and lead them to victory?

scenario.summary: A group of heretics find themselves in the middle of a fight.

li.text: The assault on the ruined fortress breaks down after a treacherous betrayal by a group of heretics. Can you lead them and lead them to victory?

ScenarioDef.label: Escape from insect
ScenarioDef.description: A group of caravaneers went to a nearby settlement for trade, but after passing by a hive of insects, arachnids followed them. After a long escape, you realized that there was nowhere to run and decided to take the fight.

ScenarioDef.label: Slave uprising
ScenarioDef.description: A group of slaves gets tired of hellish labor, eternal lack of sleep and malnutrition and decides to raise an uprising. They collect everything that can serve as a weapon and gather in a group. Either death or freedom.

ScenarioDef.label: Resonite colonization
ScenarioDef.description: A group of rezonites land on a new planet for colonization. The ship has lost its course and you find yourself on an unknown planet where you have to survive.

ScenarioDef.label: Expelled from the nest
ScenarioDef.description: A group of oryxes are expelled from the nest by the decision of the leader. They cross vast distances in the hope of finding a home.

scenario.summary: A group of oryxes have been driven out of their nest, will they be able to find a new home?

ScenarioDef.label: Oryx with offspring
ScenarioDef.description: Oryx fights off his squad during the relocation, left alone with the dangers of this world. Will it be possible to save the offspring?

scenario.summary: Oryx is left alone with his offspring.

ScenarioDef.label: Settlement of lithurs
ScenarioDef.description: The Lithur community decides to expand its borders and sends a group of Lithurs to relocate. Will they be able to fulfill the mission entrusted to them?

scenario.summary: A group of Lithurs are sent to a remote corner of the planet for colonization.

ScenarioDef.label: Awakened grax
ScenarioDef.description: A single grax awakens after an earthquake deep within the earth.

scenario.summary: Grax awakens from a long sleep.
